entries.name: Solar Installer
entries.summary: Plans and installs solar photovoltaic (PV) systems to meet customer needs, making sure installations meet regulatory and quality standards.
entries.jet_context: Solar installation is a front-line skill for the Renewable Energy workstream.

entries.name: Electrician
entries.summary: Installs, tests, maintains and repairs electrical wiring, equipment and systems in buildings and industry.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Electricians are needed across solar, charging, hydrogen plant and municipal work, so they appear in all four workstreams.

entries.name: Electrical Line Mechanic
entries.summary: Builds and maintains overhead and underground power lines and related network equipment.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Grid and transmission capacity supports renewable energy growth, including in Mpumalanga.

entries.name: Energy Efficiency Technician
entries.summary: Assesses how energy is used in buildings and facilities and helps reduce consumption through audits and technical measures.
entries.summary_source: QCTO qualification title: Energy Efficiency Technician (Energy Audit Technician)
entries.jet_context: Energy efficiency is a cross-cutting transition skill for industry and municipalities.

entries.name: Energy Engineering Technologist
entries.summary: Applies engineering knowledge at technologist level to design, test and improve energy systems.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Technologist-level skills link plant, grid and renewable energy projects.

entries.name: Energy Engineer
entries.summary: Designs and oversees energy systems and projects, including generation, efficiency and use of energy.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Energy engineers shape renewable energy project design.

entries.name: Electrical Engineer
entries.summary: Designs, develops and oversees electrical systems and equipment, from generation and networks to industrial installations.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: A scarce professional skill relevant to renewable energy, EV infrastructure and hydrogen plants. The 2024 list flags a large number of registered unemployed in this occupation, so check local demand.

entries.name: Transportation Electrician
entries.summary: Installs, diagnoses and repairs the electrical and electronic systems of vehicles.
entries.summary_source: QCTO qualification title: Transportation Electrician (Automotive Electrician)
entries.jet_context: The current route into electric-vehicle electrical work while dedicated electromobility qualifications are developed.

entries.name: Automotive Motor Mechanic
entries.summary: Services, diagnoses and repairs motor vehicles and their mechanical systems.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Motor mechanics will need top-up skills as electric and hybrid vehicles enter the fleet.

entries.name: Mechatronics Technician
entries.summary: Installs, maintains and troubleshoots equipment that combines mechanical, electrical and electronic control systems.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Mechatronics skills support automated manufacturing and plant systems.

entries.name: Electronic Equipment Mechanician
entries.summary: Fits, tests and repairs electronic equipment and control systems.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Supports electronic systems in vehicles, charging and power equipment.

entries.name: Chemical Engineer
entries.summary: Designs and optimises chemical and process plants and the processes that run in them.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Process and chemical engineering underpins green hydrogen production.

entries.name: Pipe Fitter
entries.summary: Fabricates, installs and maintains piping systems for liquids and gases.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Piping for hydrogen and other gases is central to hydrogen production and storage.

entries.name: Instrument Mechanician
entries.summary: Installs, calibrates and maintains the instruments and control equipment used to measure and control industrial processes.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Instrumentation and control skills support hydrogen plants and renewable energy facilities.

entries.name: Welder
entries.summary: Joins metal parts and structures using welding processes.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Welding is needed in plant construction, structures and equipment manufacturing.

entries.name: Chemistry Technician
entries.summary: Carries out laboratory and process testing to support chemical and related work.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Supports quality and process monitoring in chemical and hydrogen operations.

entries.name: Tanker Driver
entries.summary: Drives tankers that transport liquid or gas products by road.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Hydrogen fuel transporters have been reported as already in short supply.

entries.name: Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHE&Q) Practitioner
entries.summary: Promotes and monitors safe, healthy and environmentally sound practices in the workplace.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Safety is critical on solar, grid, battery, hydrogen and vehicle-technology sites.

entries.name: Skills Development Practitioner
entries.summary: Plans and coordinates skills development in an organisation, including workplace skills plans and training.
entries.summary_source: JET Skills Desk draft: for workstream-lead review
entries.jet_context: Connects employers with the skills system, which is the Desk's coordination role.
